sections.Aims and Fit of Module: This module aims to enable students to develop programme ideas for a television audience and make them aware of the industry standard requirements in pre-production. It will establish the fundamental requirements of developing and preparing ideas across a range of genres in studio and on location. The module also aims to give students the opportunity to work at junior levels on a live studio production and on an outside broadcast insert in the same production.
sections.Learning outcomes: A Develop a short form programme idea B Conduct basic research, development and programme planning to take their idea up to the production phase C Contribute to the production of a show.
sections.Method of teaching and learning: The teaching sessions are divided into two components (lectures and seminars). The lectures will introduce students to the notion that development is a creative phase in TV production; that to create successful TV projects, the development phase involves a substantial amount of ideation and that the development phase is only successful if there is a clear path to pre-production. The seminars will involve participatory workshops, working in the studio and working together in small groups as well as individually. Thus, students will be taught through: Lectures Participatory workshops Individual and small group work Practical sessions and Self directed learning
